note: Hook patterns are editorial starting points, not performance guarantees.

hooks.label: Specific result
hooks.risk: Do not invent or round a result for effect.

hooks.label: Mistake and cost
hooks.template: I got {thing} wrong. It cost {specific cost}.
hooks.risk: The cost must be real and attributable.

hooks.label: Evidence-backed contrarian
hooks.template: I disagree with {common advice} - for one specific reason.
hooks.risk: Disagreement needs evidence or first-hand reasoning.

hooks.label: Research finding
hooks.template: A recent study found {finding}. The important part is {limitation_or_context}.

hooks.label: Before and after
hooks.template: Before: {old state}. After: {new state}. The difference was {mechanism}.
hooks.risk: Keep the comparison fair and sourced.

hooks.label: Direct value
hooks.template: Here is the {artifact/framework/checklist} I use for {specific task}.
hooks.risk: Give useful value instead of withholding it for engagement.

hooks.label: Decision
hooks.template: I stopped {practice}. Here is the evidence that changed my mind.

hooks.label: Myth with context
hooks.template: {popular belief} is incomplete. It is true when {condition}, but not when {condition}.

hooks.label: Number with context
hooks.template: {number} sounds impressive until you compare it with {relevant baseline}.

hooks.label: First-hand observation
hooks.template: After {real experience}, one pattern kept showing up: {pattern}.
